verdict.rationale: Windmill documents versioning: Git Sync pushes a commit on each deploy, and flows have numeric version IDs. It also documents review through the Compare & Deploy page. Rollback is only implied, since Windmill can auto-deploy commits from the repository, but there is no documented one-click revert to a prior version. missing for 10: explicit documented rollback/revert workflow, version history UI details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Each time an item is deployed, Windmill will create and push a commit to the specified repository.
Flows additionally expose version-pinned webhook endpoints that target a specific flow version by its numeric version ID instead of the latest deployment.
ask it to review the changes and it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy.
CLI deployments from a Git repository
